senses.definition_en: documentary hypothesis

examples.english: The documentary hypothesis, as its name indicates, is a hypothesis that denies that Moses is the author of the Pentateuch and declares that it was actually written from four different sources.
examples.ref: 2022 November 14, Fernie Cosgrove, “¿Qué es la hipótesis documentaria?”, in Coalición por el Evangelio, archived from the original on 04 Dec 2022:
examples.text: La hipótesis documentaria [...], como su nombre lo indica, es una hipótesis que niega que Moisés sea el autor del Pentateuco y declara que en realidad fue escrito a partir de cuatro fuentes diferentes.
examples.translation: The documentary hypothesis, as its name indicates, is a hypothesis that denies that Moses is the author of the Pentateuch and declares that it was actually written from four different sources.

examples.english: The documentary hypothesis could thus explain the fact that some of the biblical stories appear twice with radical differences.
examples.ref: 2022 November 20, Pablo Cúneo, “Moisés a la luz de Signorelli”, in En el margen, archived from the original on 03 Dec 2022:
examples.text: La hipótesis documentaria pudo así explicar el hecho de que algunas de las historias bíblicas [...] aparecieran dos veces con diferencias radicales.
examples.translation: The documentary hypothesis could thus explain the fact that some of the biblical stories appear twice with radical differences.

examples.english: Even though the documentary hypothesis has been constantly reviewed and discussed, it's of enormous importance for having documented evidence that contradicts the hypothesis of a single author.
examples.ref: 2024 March, Melisa Laura Marti, “Segund que lo cuenta Moisés”, in Exlibris, number 13, archived from the original on 09 Oct 2024, page 182:
examples.text: Si bien la hipótesis documentaria ha sido constantemente revisada y discutida, es de enorme importancia por haber documentado evidencia que contradecía la hipótesis de un autor único.
examples.translation: Even though the documentary hypothesis has been constantly reviewed and discussed, it's of enormous importance for having documented evidence that contradicts the hypothesis of a single author.

glosses: documentary hypothesis
